TITLE: The Four Types of Waiting
TEXT:
There are four types of waiting.

I.  Waiting as punishment.
    (time with its arms crossed)

II. Waiting as devotion.
    (time kneeling, holding a candle)

III.Waiting as habit.
    (time smoking behind the building)

IV. Waiting as camouflage.
    (time dressed as productivity)

Most of us practice all four.
The trick is learning when to stop calling it waiting
and start calling it choosing.
